title: "🗓️ Week 08 - Surface soil moisture"

In this  week, we will know different techniques for estimation of soil moisture from SAR.


## 👨‍🏫 Lecture Slides 

[SAR Soil Moisture](https://eo4society.esa.int/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/2023_TAT10_SARSoilMoisture_WWagner_Theory.pdf).

##  Practical exercise

Install and test the PYthon Sentinel-1 soil-Moisture Mapping -[PYSMM](https://gitlab.inf.unibz.it/Felix.Greifeneder/pysmm)- library. See the documentation [here](https://pysmm.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#).

Alternatively check the algorithm  used in [100-m-resolution surface soil moisture data during the thawing season on the Qinghai‒Tibet Plateau](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-025-04831-1)

## 📚 Recommended Reading
